findings.title: Blood carries a transmissible ability rather than only a descriptive curse
findings.shown: Vampire generator requires learning and blood, excludes not-living/supernatural and six syndrome classes; adds VAMPCURSE and material-bound reference back to the originating interaction for ingestion and injection. No END is emitted on transformation effects.
findings.inferred: An actual material exposure path can therefore connect one cursed actor to another without a separate authored quest if the native engine accepts and consumes these definitions.
findings.native_unresolved: Native blood removal/containment, dose, contact routing, hidden-state reveal, stacking, transmission and cure/remove policy.

findings.title: A corpse can become a new capability source with distinct retaliation scope
findings.shown: Disturbance requires resurrection fitness, learning/speech and exclusion classes; raised actor gets a disturber-only curse plus broader animation/raise powers. Basic animation and lieutenant resurrection use different fitness gates and tags.
findings.inferred: The scene after a disturbance can acquire new threats and eligible bodies, while culpability remains actor-specific. This is a possible feedback chain, not demonstrated repeated resurrection.
findings.native_unresolved: Disturber identity lookup, action selection, corpse item ownership, corpse exhaustion/deletion, pathing, kill-to-corpse transition, cooldown scheduler and persistence.

findings.title: Weather materials connect exposure topology to anatomy and cleanup
findings.shown: Cloud material defines four exposure routes and either transformation tags or generated poison effects; regional material references use stored gas/vapor/dust state and weekly emission; poison helper emits optional END, anatomical scope and resistance/size modifiers.
findings.inferred: A material hazard can produce different aftermath for different bodies and can share a region with corpse animation. Leaving weather does not itself show syndrome removal.
findings.native_unresolved: Exposure volume, shelter, transport, dilution, anatomy evaluation, corpse eligibility after exposure, syndrome expiration engine and inactive-region policy.

findings.title: Knowledge has a physical production graph with competing material uses
findings.shown: Pig tail materials map into drink/seeds/thread/paper; recipes preserve containers, return seeds and process unpressed slurry; book binding requires already-written quire and preserves artifact status/writing by declared improvement. Secret permits research/teaching/book instruction for eligible actors.
findings.inferred: Available labor, containers, growing seasons and writing media can change future access to capabilities without awarding knowledge at manufacture time.
findings.native_unresolved: Native job reservation/cancel refunds, actual yields, writing/reading duration, knowledge validation, teaching selection, ownership and reader acquisition.

findings.title: Temporary effects, permanent capabilities and healing name different cleanup contracts
findings.shown: Week-long beast/luck clauses emit END8400; vampire/necromancer/disturbance tags omit END; summoned bogeyman/nightmare emit IE_TIME_RANGE200:300; healing names twelve physiological effects ending at12.
findings.inferred: A shared status label cannot safely imply one removal path. Ending an effect, reversing tissue damage, deleting a summoned actor, and revoking a capability are different operations.
findings.native_unresolved: Native expiration, revert-body item reconciliation, severed-part restoration, summons inventory/death handling, concentration removal and source loss.

findings.title: Visible lieutenant power definitions are not proof of generated availability
findings.shown: Four power definitions use named keys, but basic_lieutenant_powers uses ipairs. All shipped Lua were searched for interactions.powers and iterator overrides, with no conversion found. Ordinary-Lua ipairs does not visit those named keys. add_curses returns no values when num<1.
findings.inferred: Under ordinary Lua and unmodified shipped map, retry must finish via nonzero curse count, so named ice/vanish/propel/fog powers are not selected by this function. If mods add numeric entries and retry exits with powers but zero curses, nil-return assignment is a separate conditional failure path.
findings.native_unresolved: Embedded iterator bindings, active loader, mod ordering, generated raws and native consuming execution not inspected. Do not call these powers native-playable or claim a proven runtime bug.
